Module org.example.sodoku
Package com.example.sudoku.controller

Class SudokuController

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku.controller.SudokuController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISudokuController
public class SudokuController extends Object implements ISudokuController
Controller for the Sudoku game view. Handles user interaction between the view and the model.

    • buildGrid

      private void buildGrid()
      Builds the 6x6 grid of cell buttons and populates them with the model values. Fixed cells are highlighted in blue and disabled.

    • onCellClicked

      public void onCellClicked(int row, int col)
      Handles a cell click event. Selects the cell and places or erases the active number if one is selected.
      Specified by:
      onCellClicked in interface ISudokuController
      Parameters:
      row - row index of the clicked cell
      col - column index of the clicked cell

    • placeNumber

      public void placeNumber(int row, int col, int number)
      Places a number in a cell and validates it against the solution. Correct placements flash green then restore to white. Incorrect placements stay red until erased.
      Specified by:
      placeNumber in interface ISudokuController
      Parameters:
      row - row index
      col - column index
      number - number to place (1-6)

    • updateButtonState

      private void updateButtonState(int number)
      Enables or disables a number button based on its count. Disables the button when the number appears 6 times on the board.
      Parameters:
      number - number to check (1-6)

    • eraseCell

      public void eraseCell(int row, int col)
      Erases the value of the selected editable cell. Restores cell to white and updates counters.
      Specified by:
      eraseCell in interface ISudokuController
      Parameters:
      row - row index
      col - column index

    • restoreCellStyle

      private void restoreCellStyle(int row, int col)
      Restores a cell's background based on its current state. Red if wrong, white if empty or correct.
      Parameters:
      row - row index
      col - column index

    • selectNumber

      public void selectNumber(int number)
      Selects a number to place or activates the eraser. If the same number is already selected, deselects it. Highlights all cells on the board that already contain that number. If a cell is already selected, places or erases immediately.
      Specified by:
      selectNumber in interface ISudokuController
      Parameters:
      number - number to select (1-6), or -1 for eraser

    • highlightSelectedButton

      private void highlightSelectedButton(int number)
      Highlights the active number button and resets the others.
      Parameters:
      number - currently selected number (-1 for eraser, 0 for none)

      public void onKeyPressed(javafx.scene.input.KeyEvent event)

      Parameters:

    • highlightSameNumbers

      private void highlightSameNumbers(int number)
      Highlights all cells on the board that contain the given number. Clears highlights first, then marks matching cells in light purple. Respects red cells (incorrect placements) and fixed cells (blue).
      Parameters:
      number - number to highlight (1-6), or 0 to just clear
